input.body:
Weekly `claudinite-growth/rule-revalidation` run. Context scoped this run to `.claudinite/local/packs` (repo-mechanics, session-tooling, site-copy). Only `session-tooling` carried revalidatable claims — `repo-mechanics` and `site-copy` are judgment/process prose with no falsifiable environment facts.

Closes #208

## Verdicts

| Claim (session-tooling) | Probe | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| GITHUB_TOKEN is structurally forbidden from pushing to `.github/workflows/` | `WebSearch` on GitHub's own docs/discussions (WebFetch to `docs.github.com` is itself `EGRESS_BLOCKED` in this sandbox) — confirmed: the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files; only a PAT with `workflow` scope can | `doc-verified` |
| `fields` subset narrows response size on `search_issues` / `list_issues` | Read the live tool schemas via `ToolSearch` — both carry a `fields` array param | `holds` |
| `fields` subset narrows response size on `search_repositories` too | Read the live `search_repositories` schema — **no `fields` param exists**; the actual knob is `minimal_output` (default `true`) | `stale (corrected)` |
| `actions_list` has no `fields`/`minimal_output`, and `per_page` doesn't shrink oversized results | Read the live schema (confirmed no such params) + called `actions_list list_workflow_runs` with `per_page: 3`, got back far more than 3 runs | `holds` |
| For a PR, prefer `get_files`/`get_commits`/`get_check_runs` over `get` | Read the live `pull_request_read` schema — all three methods present | `holds` |
| `WebFetch` egress-blocks some domains with a distinct `EGRESS_BLOCKED` error (not a publisher 403), `gartner.com` among them | Called `WebFetch` on `https://www.gartner.com/` — got back the exact `{"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED",...}` shape named in the rule | `holds` |
| `codeload.github.com` is blocked, `curl … \| tar` returns 403 | `curl`'d a real tarball from `codeload.github.com` for this repo — **200 OK, valid gzip, extracts cleanly** | `stale (corrected — deleted)` |
| `enable_pr_auto_merge` can never arm here because `main` carries no branch-protection rule | No read-only tool in this session's toolset reads branch-protection state, and calling `enable_pr_auto_merge` itself risks actually arming auto-merge on a real PR if the claim is now false (a write side-effect, out of bounds for a probe) | `unprobed (no safe read-only path to repo-specific branch-protection state)` |
| `ScheduleWakeup` requires `prompt` unless `stop: true` | Read the tool's own loaded schema — `prompt` marked "Required unless `stop` is true" | `holds` |
| `search_issues` is natural-language semantic matching, not qualifier filtering | Read the live tool description — verbatim: "Search issues using natural-language semantic matching" | `holds` |
| `list_issues` with `fields`+`perPage:100`, no `state` filter, returns "all 80 issues" in one call | Called it live — `totalCount: 131`, `pageInfo.hasNextPage: true` at `perPage: 100` | `stale (corrected)` |

## Corrections made

1. **`search_repositories` doesn't take `fields`.** Split the "pass a `fields` subset" bullet so it no longer lumps `search_repositories` in with `search_issues`/`list_issues`; named `minimal_output` as its actual (and already-default) size knob.
2. **`codeload.github.com` is no longer blocked.** Deleted the bullet outright — the surface it warned about is gone, so there's nothing left to instruct.
3. **"All 80 issues come back in one call" is now false** (131 issues, already past one page). Replaced the fixed count with a check on `pageInfo.hasNextPage`/`endCursor` so the guidance doesn't just go stale again at the next growth milestone.

Each correction gets a dated row in `session-tooling/VERSIONS.md` (new file — the pack had none yet).

`repo-mechanics` and `site-copy` are untouched — nothing in either pack asserts a fact a platform change could falsify.

## Unrelated fix in the same branch

The session's Stop hook blocked on a pre-existing `reference-integrity` finding unrelated to the above: `product-wiki/brand/README.md` still linked to `.claudinite-checks.json`, which was folded into `.claudinite-settings.json` back in `0b2fc78` and never updated at the call site. Fixed the one link (second commit).

`node .claudinite/shared/engine/checks/check_the_world.mjs` exits clean on this branch.

## Note on #208

This session could not run the queue's `converge-item.mjs` step — it needs direct `GITHUB_TOKEN` REST API access, which this execution channel doesn't have (MCP-only). Left a comment on #208 explaining the blocker instead of hand-converging it; it needs a person (or a run from a context with real token access) to close it out.
